title: Governance Document Inventory v1
description: Machine-readable inventory of all governance documents with their classifications, mixed-section records, dispositions, and canonical links. This is the sole machine-readable governance metadata authority for Railyard. Every in-scope artifact appears in documents; every out-of-scope artifact is covered by an exclusion rule. Documents and exclusions must be disjoint: no document path may appear in exclusions.

inventory_id.description: Stable identifier for this inventory instance.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the inventory schema used.

authority_rule.description: Declares the authority relationship between this inventory and embedded frontmatter in individual documents.

documents.description: Inventory entries for every in-scope governance document.

path.description: Relative repository path to the governance document. Must start without ./ and use forward slashes.

metadata.description: Governance metadata conforming to the governance-document-metadata-v1 schema.

mixed_sections.description: Sections within this document that belong to a different governance kind than the document's primary kind.

heading.description: The heading text that introduces the mixed section.

secondary_kind.description: The governance kind of this section, which differs from the document's primary kind.

canonical_target.description: Relative path to the canonical document that owns this section's governance kind.

disposition.description: How this mixed section or the document as a whole is placed relative to canonical authority.

canonical_links.description: Links from this document to canonical authorities for topics it references.

topic.description: The topic for which this link points to the canonical document.

canonical_document.description: Relative path to the canonical document that owns this topic.

exclusions.description: Explicitly excluded file patterns with reasons. Every in-scope artifact appears in documents; every out-of-scope artifact is covered by an exclusion rule. Document paths and exclusion patterns must be disjoint.

pattern.description: Glob-like pattern or directory prefix identifying excluded artifacts.

reason.description: Why this pattern is excluded from the governance inventory.
